# Gramlot 0.3.30

## Breaking change: system Data paths

System Data now uses the `_gramlot` root. Update application bindings from
`gramlot.device.*`, `gramlot.drawing.*` and `gramlot.grid.*` to their
`_gramlot.device.*`, `_gramlot.drawing.*` and `_gramlot.grid.*` counterparts.
There are no compatibility aliases. Mobile shells must ship matching Source
and embedded runtime. Native bridge names and persistent storage keys do not change.

## Components and authoring

- Shared charts with lazy external engines, maps, 3D views, time controls and reactive Data configuration; frameGrid creates its chart command from chart options.
- Audio analysis and image annotation components, with complete component references.
- Grid checkbox sets, primary-record radio columns, distinct-value and date filters, and shared search controls.
- Editable checkBoxText descriptions with codes in Data, hierarchical choices and shared Tree checkbox behavior.
- Label menus and shared tools/Inspector components; remove provisional legacy widgets.
- Standard collections are available through the environment Page base; external engines load when used.

## Verification and documentation

Local qualification: 1879 JavaScript tests passed; 434 Python tests passed with
5 expected failures. Completed human and compact collection references, including
Audio and Drawing (36 public pages and 15 downloadable guide resources).

Hosted and standalone asset tests passed. Actual browser opening of file exports
and physical mobile-device qualification remain manual verification limitations;
this release does not claim those checks. Invoice application is excluded.

## Release qualification

Build shared collection assets before the Inspector browser suite. Fixture HTTP responses read resources before sending headers, so missing assets report 404 instead of terminating the test server.

Choice popup focus preserves container scroll. Core browser fixtures serve the actual standard collection resources and runtime import maps. Locale tests follow the platform Intl formatter; fixture TTL is ten seconds with all renewal and deliberately wrong-TTL assertions retained. Production TTL is unchanged.
